id: title:Gilbert09:retry a client side temporal rpc timeout

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion pipeline reliability: distinguishes transient RPC cancellations from permanent failures, allowing recovery and preventing dropped triggers.
review.reason: Adds transient status handling and retryability checks for warehouse ingestion RPCs. This could prevent permanent loss of warehouse ingestion triggers during transient client-side cancellations, improving ingestion reliability. No adoption or incident avoidance is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on the supplied hunk; no broader context or test results are available. The benefit is inferred rather than demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context or truncation. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds a dictionary mapping RPCStatusCode.CANCELLED to transient message phrases, and extends the retryability check to include these messages alongside DEADLINE_EXCEEDED and UNAVAILABLE.
observations.code_quote: if any(phrase in exc.message for phrase in _RETRYABLE_RPC_MESSAGES_BY_STATUS.get(exc.status, ())):
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion pipeline to retry transient client-side RPC cancellations rather than permanently dropping the trigger, while still distinguishing genuine cancellations from transient timeouts.
